Subject: Data residency + deletion SLA questions (Horizon Health)

Hi Sofia,

Quick one from our security/compliance team as we move toward PO for Redwood Dedicated: we need to confirm a few items for the order form and SLA before procurement signs off. Can you confirm the following for hosted vs. dedicated/deployed options?

1) Residency: We require customer data to reside in US-only regions for Horizon's account. Does Redwood guarantee region-locked storage for (a) user content, (b) KV/cache, and (c) model-derived embeddings? If yes, how is that enforced in the order form?

2) Retention: We need bespoke retention windows by data class. For example: PII (identifiers) = 30 days, EHR-linked metadata = 365 days, analytics/usage logs = 90 days, KV cache = 7 days. Can we set per-class retention in the SLA/order form, and will Redwood automatically enforce deletions?

3) Deletion timeline & certification: When we request account termination or a data-subject deletion, what are the guaranteed timelines for: immediate purge, backup/replica expunge, and certification that data was destroyed? We need a cert within 30 days ideally.

4) Attachments & proof: legal asked for sample language we can put into our order form, and an export template showing the fields that will be deleted by class and timestamp. Could you share a short proposal and any supporting docs?

Thanks — if easier we can hop on a 30-min call but written language is preferred for procurement.

Sam
Sam Jacobs
Head of Compliance, Horizon Health

Sam — thanks for the clear list. Short answers up front, then a proposed path: 

- Residency: Yes — for Dedicated (reserved/private) we can guarantee US-only residency at rest and in-flight via the order form controls and our Private control plane. For hosted accounts we can pin region to US-only clusters; we will include a residency clause in the OF that binds storage and logs to the US region specified.

- Retention: We support per-customer retention schedules by data class. We can enforce automated deletion workflows (including KV/cache eviction rules) driven by the retention matrix in the order form.

- Deletion timelines & certs: Proposed default timelines (we can make these bespoke on OF):
  • Operational purge (token/user content): within 7 calendar days of request
  • Backups and geo-replicas: within 30 days of purge
  • Low-priority analytics aggregates: configurable (default 90 days)
  • Certificate of deletion: provided within 30 days of completed purge

- Next steps: I attached a retention schedule template (Horizon_Retention_Schedule_v1.xlsx) and a short playbook (Redwood-Data-Deletion-Playbook.pdf). If this looks good, I can draft an Order Form excerpt with explicit OF fields (resident_region, retention_matrix, deletion_cert_window) and a clause you can paste into procurement language.

If you want a single-line summary for PO: "Redwood will store Horizon data in US-only infrastructure and will enforce Horizon's retention matrix as set in the Order Form; deletion processes will complete within the timelines defined in the retention matrix and Redwood will provide a certificate of deletion within 30 days post-purge."

Would you like that drafted as an OF clause (DocuSign-ready) or as redline language for your legal team?

— Sofia

1) Residency: Redwood confirms US-only residency per the Resident_Region field on the Order Form. For Dedicated (reserved) deployments, the control plane and storage will be provisioned in the chosen US region and will not leave that region.

2) Retention (per Horizon matrix): we will enforce the retention matrix exactly as entered in the OF. Please fill and return the attached "Horizon_Retention_Schedule_v1.xlsx". Example defaults we discussed: PII=30d, EHR_metadata=365d, Analytics_logs=90d, KV_cache=7d.

3) Deletion & Certs: Operational purge = 7 days after validated request. Backups/replicas cleared within 30 days after purge; certificate of deletion provided within 30 days after backups cleared. If you require an expedited 72-hour purge we can offer that as a paid option — this will be listed in the OF under "expedited_deletion_fee".

4) Audit & Proof: Redwood can provide deletion audit logs as an add-on and will include a signed Certificate of Deletion (pdf) showing data classes and timestamps. The Certificate will include: data class, described objects (counts where feasible), timestamps for purge start/completion, and the engineer/officer who signed the certificate.

Attached: Horizon_Retention_Schedule_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), Redwood-Data-Deletion-Playbook.pdf (overview), OrderForm_Horizon_SLA_excerpt.docx (DocuSign-ready).
